§6Logistics Drones§f

§aSmarter drones that auto-detect provider and requester crates. No route programming needed.§f

Logistics Drones work differently from transport drones. They automatically form networks and detect crates within a §e5§f chunk radius. They move at §e7.5§f blocks/s.

Components: §bLogistics Drone Dock§f (holds up to 9 drones), §bProvider Crate§f (supplies items), §bRequester Crate§f (requests specific items via filters), and §bWaypoints§f (extend range).

Crafting: Logistics Drone = Microchip + Transport Drone. Dock = Steel Crate + Military Grade Circuit Board. Provider Crate = Waypoint + Steel Crate + Blue Crayon. Requester Crate = Waypoint + Steel Crate + Yellow Crayon.

§ePS:§f Place a dock with drones, a provider crate, and a requester crate. They handle the rest. No manual routing required.
